subject.title: refactor(qa): retire the standalone Matrix QA runtime

question: Should this draft be allowed to retire the standalone `qa-matrix` package and route Matrix release QA through QA Lab after dependency graph and reusable-workflow security boundaries are approved?
rationale: The direction matches the QA Lab owner boundary, but the branch changes package ownership, plugin-facing QA runner shape, lockfile importers, and secret-adjacent workflow routing that automation should not approve without maintainer/security intent.

options.title: Approve after guarded review
options.body: Fix the two P3 skill-doc issues, obtain dependency/security approval for the exact head, refresh from current main, and continue toward merge.

options.title: Keep draft for workflow rework
options.body: Keep the architecture but require a narrower workflow or security-boundary rewrite before marking the branch ready.

options.title: Do not retire qa-matrix yet
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers want to preserve the standalone Matrix QA package for this release cycle.

recommendation.title: Approve after guarded review
recommendation.body: Fix the two P3 skill-doc issues, obtain dependency/security approval for the exact head, refresh from current main, and continue toward merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent QA live workflow and release evidence guard history makes this the best available owner for the workflow/security-boundary choice.
